blocks.prompt: 4 (i) Find the domain and the range of the function \(g\) defined below: \(g(x) = 5 - x\).
blocks.explanation:
Pehle do lafz yaad karein: domain (woh inputs jo hum function mein daal sakte hain) aur range (woh outputs jo waqai bahar aate hain).
Diya kya hai? \(g(x) = 5 - x\), ek seedhi line.
Find kya karna hai? Domain aur range.
Plan: domain ke liye dekhein kya ghalat ho sakta hai; range ke liye \(y = 5 - x\) ko \(x\) ke liye solve karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(g(x) = 5 - x\).
Humein find karna hai: domain aur range.
Tareeqa: Domain sirf do cheezein chhota karti hain: negative number ka square root, ya zero se divide. Range ke liye dekhte hain ke kya har \(y\) koi na koi input se aata hai.

Domain
\[\text{Domain } g = (-\infty, \infty)\]
Kyun: \(5 - x\) mein na root hai na fraction. Kisi bhi real \(x\) ke liye \(5 - x\) nikal sakta hai, is liye saare real numbers allowed hain.

Range
\[y = 5 - x \Rightarrow x = 5 - y\]
Kyun: Koi bhi real \(y\) socho; input \(x = 5 - y\) bhi real hai, aur \(g(5 - y) = 5 - (5 - y) = y\). Yani har real number output ban sakta hai. Is liye range bhi saare real numbers.

Tasdeeq
\[y = 100:\; x = -95,\ g(-95) = 100 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Koi bara sa output chuna, 100, aur us ka input \(-95\) mil gaya. Seedhi line (jo horizontal na ho) upar neeche kahin nahi rukti, is liye range poori real line hai.

blocks.prompt: 4 (ii) Find the domain and the range of the function \(g\) defined below: \(g(x) = \sqrt{x + 2}\).
blocks.explanation:
Square root wala function hai, is liye andar ka number negative nahi ho sakta.
Diya kya hai? \(g(x) = \sqrt{x + 2}\).
Find kya karna hai? Allowed inputs (domain) aur outputs (range).
Plan: \(x + 2 \ge 0\) solve karna; range ke liye yeh fact ke square root kabhi negative nahi hota.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(g(x) = \sqrt{x + 2}\).
Humein find karna hai: domain aur range.
Tareeqa: Domain \(x + 2 \ge 0\) se. Range ke liye yaad rakhein ke \(\sqrt{\ }\) ka nishan hamesha zero ya positive value deta hai.

Domain
\[x + 2 \ge 0 \Rightarrow x \ge -2\]
\[\text{Domain } g = [-2, \infty)\]
Kyun: Negative ka square root real nahi. \(x = -2\) par \(\sqrt{0} = 0\) bilkul theek hai, is liye \(-2\) shamil hai aur square bracket \([\ \) lagta hai. \(\infty\) koi number nahi, us ke saath hamesha round bracket.

Range
\[g(-2) = 0,\ g(2) = 2,\ g(98) = 10\]
\[\text{Range } g = [0, \infty)\]
Kyun: Sab se chhota output 0 hai jo \(x = -2\) par aata hai. \(x\) barhta hai to output bhi barhta hai, aur koi upper limit nahi. Har \(y \ge 0\) ke liye input \(x = y^2 - 2\) milta hai jo \(-2\) se chhota nahi.
Dhyan dein: Range mein negative numbers likhna aam ghalti hai; root ka output kabhi negative nahi.

Tasdeeq
\[y = 3:\; x = 7,\ \sqrt{9} = 3 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Output 3 chuna, input \(3^2 - 2 = 7\) mila, aur \(\sqrt{7 + 2} = 3\). Range ka har number waqai aata hai.

blocks.prompt: 4 (iii) [printed as (iv); the book skips the label (iii)] Find the domain and the range of the function \(g\) defined below: \(g(x) = \begin{cases} 6x + 7, & x \le -2 \\ 4 - 3x, & x > -2 \end{cases}\).
blocks.explanation:
Note: kitab mein is part ka label (iv) chhapa hai, kyunke label (iii) chhoot gaya hai; hum tarteeb se (iii) likh rahe hain.
Yeh piecewise function (tukron wala function) hai: \(x \le -2\) ke liye ek rule, \(x > -2\) ke liye doosra.
Find kya karna hai? Domain aur range.
Plan: har tukre ke outputs alag alag us ke apne interval par nikalna (endpoint shamil hai ya nahi, yeh dhyan se), phir dono ka union (jor).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(x \le -2\) ke liye \(g(x) = 6x + 7\); \(x > -2\) ke liye \(g(x) = 4 - 3x\).
Humein find karna hai: domain aur range.
Tareeqa: Domain ke liye dekhna hai ke har \(x\) kisi tukre mein aata hai ya nahi. Range ke liye har tukre ke outputs nikal kar jor dena hai. Piecewise function ka range kabhi bhi andaze se nahi likhna chahiye.

Domain
\[(-\infty, -2] \cup (-2, \infty) = (-\infty, \infty)\]
Kyun: Har real number ya to \(-2\) ke barabar/chhota hai ya bara. Dono rules seedhi lines hain, na root na fraction. Is liye har \(x\) allowed hai.

Pehle tukre ke outputs (\(x \le -2\))
\[g(-2) = 6(-2) + 7 = -5\]
\[\text{outputs } (-\infty, -5]\]
Kyun: Slope 6 positive hai, yani \(x\) barhe to output barhta hai. Is tukre mein sab se bara \(x\) khud \(-2\) hai (shamil, kyunke \(\le\)). Wahan output \(-5\). Baen taraf jayein to output neeche hi neeche jata hai. Is liye \(-5\) samait us se neeche sab.

Doosre tukre ke outputs (\(x > -2\))
\[4 - 3(-2) = 10 \text{ (not reached)}\]
\[\text{outputs } (-\infty, 10)\]
Kyun: Slope \(-3\) negative hai, yani \(x\) barhe to output ghatta hai. Sab se bare outputs \(-2\) ke bilkul daen taraf hain. \(x = -2\) is tukre mein shamil nahi (\(>\) hai, \(\ge\) nahi), is liye output 10 ke bohat qareeb jata hai lekin 10 kabhi nahi banta. Misaal: \(x = -1.99\) par \(9.97\).

Dono tukron ka union
\[(-\infty, -5] \cup (-\infty, 10) = (-\infty, 10)\]
Kyun: \((-\infty, -5]\) poora ka poora \((-\infty, 10)\) ke andar hai, is liye jor \((-\infty, 10)\) hi hai. 10 ya us se bara koi output nahi aata.
Dhyan dein: Sirf "dono lines hain, to range saare real numbers" kehna ghalat hai; har tukra apne interval tak mehdood hai.

Tasdeeq
\[x = -1.9:\; g = 4 + 5.7 = 9.7\]
\[x = -3:\; g = -18 + 7 = -11\]
Kyun: Outputs 10 ke qareeb aate hain lekin neeche rehte hain; graph mein bhi \((-2, 10)\) par khula (khaali) circle hai. Agar output 12 chahiye to \(4 - 3x = 12\) se \(x = -\frac{8}{3}\) aata hai, jo \(> -2\) nahi, aur pehla tukra to \(-5\) se upar jata hi nahi. Is liye 12 range mein nahi.

answer_figure.alt: Graph of the piecewise function g on axes from x = -4 to 4. For x up to -2 it is the steep rising line y = 6x + 7, ending in a filled dot at (-2, -5). For x greater than -2 it is the falling line y = 4 - 3x, starting at an open circle at (-2, 10) and going down to the right through (0, 4) and crossing the x-axis at 4/3. A dashed horizontal line at y = 10 shows the height that is never reached.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein chaar parts wale sawal ke paanch jawab (i) se (v) chhape hain, aur us ka (iv) is piecewise function ki Range \((-\infty, \infty)\) batata hai. Yeh ghalat hai: koi input 10 ya us se bara output nahi deta. Sahi range \((-\infty, 10)\) hai; domain \((-\infty, \infty)\) sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 4 (iv) [printed as (v); the book skips the label (iii)] Find the domain and the range of the function \(g\) defined below: \(g(x) = |x - 5|\).
blocks.explanation:
Note: kitab mein is part ka label (v) hai; label (iii) chhootne ki wajah se hum tarteeb se (iv) likh rahe hain.
Absolute value function: \(|\ |\) kisi number ka sign hata kar sirf us ka size deta hai, jaise \(|-3| = 3\).
Find kya karna hai? Domain aur range.
Plan: har real number ka absolute value hota hai; absolute value kabhi negative nahi.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(g(x) = |x - 5|\).
Humein find karna hai: domain aur range.
Tareeqa: Domain mein kuch ghalat nahi ho sakta. Range: \(|x - 5| \ge 0\), aur 0 tab aata hai jab andar 0 ho, yani \(x = 5\).

Domain
\[\text{Domain } g = (-\infty, \infty)\]
Kyun: Har real \(x\) ke liye \(x - 5\) ek real number hai, aur har real number ka absolute value nikal sakta hai.

Range
\[g(5) = 0,\ g(8) = 3,\ g(2) = 3\]
\[\text{Range } g = [0, \infty)\]
Kyun: Sab se chhota output 0 (at \(x = 5\)). 5 se kisi bhi taraf door jayein to output barhta jata hai, bina kisi limit ke. Har \(y \ge 0\) ke liye input \(x = 5 + y\) mil jata hai. Negative output namumkin hai.

Tasdeeq
\[y = 7:\; x = 12,\ |12 - 5| = 7 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Output 7 chuna to input 12 mila. Aur \(g(x) = -1\) ka koi hal nahi, kyunke absolute value negative nahi hoti. Is liye range \([0, \infty)\) hi hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key ka (v) \(g(x) = |x - 5|\) ki Range \((-\infty, 2) \cup [7, \infty)\) batata hai. Yeh ghalat hai: absolute value kabhi negative nahi hoti, aur har \(y \ge 0\) aata hai. Sahi jawab: Domain \((-\infty, \infty)\), Range \([0, \infty)\). Dilchasp baat: key ki faltu "(iii)" wali line (Domain \((-\infty, \infty)\), Range \([0, \infty)\)) asal mein isi part ka sahi jawab hai.
